messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Dress the person in the complete outfit shown from the front and back in the reference images, consisting of the one-piece garment and the footwear. This replaces the current outfit entirely, rather than adding items to it. Preserve everything else in the video. The first reference image shows the front view of the complete outfit, and the second shows its back view.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Dress the person in the complete outfit shown from the front and back in the reference images, consisting of the one-piece garment and the footwear. This replaces the current outfit entirely, rather than adding items to it. Preserve everything else in the video. The first reference image shows the front view of the complete outfit, and the second shows its back view.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands in profile, then turns his head and body slightly, raises his right hand to his face, and then returns to a standing position.","camera":"A static, medium shot from the side, keeping the character centered in the frame.","clothing":"A light blue and white plaid button-up shirt with rolled-up sleeves, brown leather suspenders, and dark plaid trousers.","hair_color":"White.","hairstyle":"Short white hair with a small top-knot bun at the back of the head.","identity":"A 3D-rendered male character with a slim build, dark skin, and a short beard.","scene":"A cobblestone street in front of a dark, ornate storefront with signs reading 'SOAP' and 'COCOA POWDER'."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The character's pink/cream tank top and pink shorts were replaced by a light blue/white plaid button-up shirt with rolled sleeves, brown suspenders, and dark plaid trousers. The character's pose, hair, face, scene, and camera remained consistent.
arguments.requested_change: Replace the character's current outfit entirely with the complete reference outfit: light plaid shirt, brown suspenders, dark plaid trousers, and black shoes, while preserving all other video content.
uncertain: Black shoes are not clearly visible in the medium shot, so footwear replacement cannot be confirmed.
unexpected_changes: The reference bow tie is not visible in the output.
